content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Management Trainee Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Selected trainees will support the company's housing finance business by acquiring customers, developing sales channels, maintaining builder relationships and assisting with preliminary loan assessment. Identify and acquire new customers through online and offline sales activities. Generate housing loan, Loan Against Property (LAP) and other retail loan business. Identify potential housing projects and develop relationships with builders and developers. Support achievement of sales and business development targets. Guide customers regarding loan products, eligibility and required documents. Support the in-house sales team and distribution channels. Coordinate with Direct Selling Agents (DSAs) and Marketing Intermediaries. Monitor channel partner performance and provide required support. Assist in preliminary loan appraisal and underwriting. Follow applicable credit policies and compliance requirements. Coordinate with internal teams for loan processing. Monitor market developments and provide business feedback.
